name: Couple Breaker
source:
“If you had the chance to get revenge on the ex who cheated… would you take it?”

Taerin Yang, who had it all—until betrayal shattered her world.
Now, she’s stepping into the spotlight on a reality romance game show to get back at her cheating ex.
But there's a twist—she'll need a partner.

Teaming up with her rival, Ju-a Gong’s ex, the two begin a fake relationship for revenge—but sparks start flying.
As join the show, Taerin’s heart and loyalty are tested.

Can you achieve the perfect revenge? Or will you fall for true love along the way?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.p37client]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“如果你有机会向出轨的前任报仇……你会接受吗？”

泰林·杨，她拥有一切——直到背叛粉碎了她的世界。
现在，她在一个真人爱情游戏节目中成为众人瞩目的焦点，以报复她出轨的前任。
但有一个转折——她需要一个伴侣。

为了报复，两人​​与她的对手、孔珠阿的前夫联手，开始建立假关系，但火花开始四溅。
当加入这个节目时，泰林的心和忠诚度受到了考验。

你能实现完美的复仇吗？还是一路上你会爱上真爱？
